sources.snippet: Open-source orchestration for teams of AI agents. If OpenClaw is an employee, Paperclip is the company. Paperclip is a Node.js server and React UI that orchestrates a team of AI agents to run a business. Bring your own agents, assign goals, and track work and costs from one dashboard.
